We are looking for an analytical and customer-focused Junior Technical Support Specialist to join our team and become the technical anchor for our clients. In this role you will support domain experts in model/AI risk management, model development, model validation,… who rely on us for complex product queries, custom configurations and bug resolution. This requires a deep understanding of our solutions and the ability to solve technical puzzles. You will take full ownership of client questions ensuring that users receive the right advice, can use the product effectively and have their issues resolved quickly and efficiently. As you master our platform and understand the different configurations of our clients, this role offers a clear growth path towards an implementation consultant or customer success account management role.
 

How you'll make an impact
 
 

• Take ownership of complex product inquiries, guiding our customers through technical challenges and platform usage via our service desk. 

• Adapt and adjust existing custom configurations tailored to the needs of our clients. 

• Create and maintain 
customer-facing support documentation and tutorial videos. 

• Thoroughly reproduce, verify and analyze reported bugs, resolving what you can and 
accurately translating issues for the product team. 

• Own the end-to-end communication for client issues, ensuring the user stays informed and guided even when an issue is escalated. 

• Build a deep 
understanding of each client’s specific setup to provide proactive support. 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams (product team, Information Security team) to ensure timely and high-quality support. 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience in a similar role. 

• A customer-centric professional with 
excellent communication skills who genuinely enjoys helping experts solve complex problems. 

• Fluency in 
English ( 
spoken and written) is an absolute must. 

• Ability to translate business needs or functional problems into 
clear technical requirements. 

• A 
strong analytical mindset. You don’t just pass along an issue, you investigate the root cause and resolve the issue yourself or introduce short-term workarounds to unblock the client. 

• A strong affinity for 
complex enterprise SaaS software solutions combined with the eagerness to learn about MRM and AI governance. 

• Python skills are a plus. 

• Hands-on experience in database and SQL is a plus. 

• A high 
ownership mentality, taking full responsibility issues from the moment they are raised until the final solution is communicated. 

• An 
ambitious individual looking to grow into an implementation consultant expert or account manager role focused on deep product expertise.

jobs.occupation: Comptable AP Team leader English and French
jobs.description:
The Bilingual (French and English) AP Team Leader Accountant will oversee the Accounts Payable function, ensuring the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments. The role also includes mentoring and training a Junior Accountant while supporting continuous process improvement and team efficiency.

Client Details

Our client is an international company located in Liege.

Description

As an AP Team Leader Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Supervise and manage the accounts payable team to ensure smooth operations.
• Mentoring and training Junior Accountants to support their professional development and strengthen their technical accounting skills.
• Oversee invoice processing and payment approvals in compliance with company policies.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external vendors to resolve payment discrepancies.
• Maintain accurate records of all accounts payable transactions.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal controls.
• Prepare and review reports related to accounts payable performance.
• Support month-end and year-end closing processes as required.
• Propose process improvements to enhance efficiency in the accounts payable function.

A successful AP Team Leader Accountant should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Experience in accounts payable or similar financial operations roles.
• Strong organisational and team management skills.
• Proficiency in Excel.
• Knowledge of French and English.
• Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
• Good communication skills for liaising with vendors and internal teams.
• Problem-solving abilities to address payment or process issues effectively.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Residence in Liege.

For an international organization within the medical sector based in Ghent, we are looking for an experienced Accountant to support the financial management of the Belgian operations. In this varied role, you will take broad responsibility for a range of financial and accounting processes.

Your responsibilities:

• You will manage the full accounting cycle (A to Z) for the Belgian entity and its related holding structure.
• You will be responsible for both general and analytical accounting, ensuring the accuracy and quality of financial data.
• You will act as the main point of contact for accounting and financial matters within the organization.
• You will handle monthly and annual closings and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
• You will prepare annual accounts and various statutory and tax filings, including VAT, Intrastat and statistical reporting.
• You will monitor outstanding receivables and payables and process payments and payroll-related accounting entries.
• You will work closely with external partners and advisors on tax matters, subsidies and other financial topics.
• You will support the annual audit process and act as a key contact during financial audits.
• You will contribute to budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis, helping to identify and explain deviations from financial targets.
• You will perform balance sheet reconciliations and controls, ensuring that discrepancies are identified and followed up appropriately.
• You will actively contribute to the improvement and optimization of financial processes, systems and procedures, working closely with the corporate finance team.

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
• You have at least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting.
• You have a strong knowledge of general and analytical accounting.
• Experience in an international or corporate environment is considered an advantage.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• You have strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• You are independent, proactive and solution-oriented, while also being a strong team player.
• You are able to set priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy, even when working under tight deadlines.
• You are IT-minded and comfortable working with ERP systems and Excel.

Barman — Nando
 

Where Italian nostalgia meets real bar craft
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant — it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Barman to own our bar: someone who mixes with precision, keeps the bar running like clockwork during service, and makes every guest feel like they've pulled up a stool at Nonna's counter.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Prepare and serve drinks — cocktails, wine, coffee, aperitivo classics — accurately and efficiently 

• Welcome guests at the bar and set the tone for their evening 

• Keep the bar stocked, clean, and ready before service hits 

• Manage the pace of orders during busy periods without losing quality or friendliness 

• Coordinate with the floor team so drinks and food orders stay in sync 

• Handle guest requests and resolve minor issues with a calm, professional touch  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a barman/bartender in hospitality 

• Solid knowledge of classic cocktails, wine, and Italian aperitivo culture 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, hygiene- and detail-conscious 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €15.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real ownership of the bar from day one  

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

Air Cargo Belgium (ACB) is the official representative of the air cargo community at Brussels Airport Cargo. With over 
170 member companies, we bring together airlines, handlers, forwarders, the airport authority and other stakeholders. We connect, inspire, and 
strengthen the Brussels air cargo community through events, projects and communication.
 

Every year we organize several events that range from content-driven seminars with 20 participants, to bigger networking events like our BBQ with over 700 guests, to more leisurely events like a football tournament. Additionally, we also organize smaller activities like handing out Easter Eggs.
 

With our renewed strategy, we aim to grow from 
3,000 yearly event visitors/participants to over 7,000 in the coming years. This means more events, new ideas on how to best reach our audiences and more strong communication! To make this happen, we’re looking for a 
Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.
 

Your Role:As our new Community Engagement Coordinator, you will:
 

Events & Coordination
 
 

• Take the lead in event coordination from A to Z, including the planning, promotion and execution of workshops, seminars, networking events and larger community events. 

• Work closely with our Community Engagement Lead, another coordinator and the wider ACB team to ensure smooth event organization and execution. 

• Occasionally represent ACB, and support the community, at international fairs and events.  

Communication & Content
 
 

• Manage and grow ACB’s social media presence in collaboration with your community engagement colleagues, using tools such as Canva and scheduling tools to create engaging and professional content. 

• Create engaging content for newsletters, social media and online updates, highlighting community news, success stories and relevant information 

• Support the promotion and visibility of ACB’s initiatives, events and community activities.  

Community Engagement & Partnerships
 
 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with our member companies and act as a central point of contact for the community. 

• Contribute to and execute ACB’s community engagement strategy, tailored to the dynamics of the air cargo industry. 

• Gather feedback from community members and translate it into actionable recommendations to continuously improve our community engagement 

• Support the growth of memberships and sponsorships by attracting and engaging relevant stakeholders. 

• Identify and develop partnerships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen the visibility and impact of the ACB community. 

• Monitor engagement metrics and data and report on the results and impact of community engagement initiatives. 

• Act as a visible presence within the community by visiting members to share information, gather feedback, distribute materials and support campaigns or initiatives. 

Your Profile:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Event Management or Marketing (or similar). 

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience (preferred). 

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English (all external communication). 

• Good knowledge of Dutch (our internal team language). 

• Good knowledge of French, as the role involves direct contact with warehouse staff. 

• Hands-on experience with graphic design (e.g. designing posters with Canva or similar) and a good eye for visual communication. 

• Social media fluency and confidence in creating and managing engaging content across platforms. 

• A people-oriented personality: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships and making new contacts. 

• A proactive attitude: you take initiative, see what needs to be done and act on it. 

• A valid category B driving licence (required for driving a van/minibus for our events). 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Open to learning about aviation and air cargo and connecting with major players in the industry.  

A standard desk job isn’t enough for you — you love variety, dynamism and contact with people.

Experience in building applications for web, mobile, desktop, or gaming? You’ll be familiar with .NET by Microsoft. This open-source, cross-platform framework (compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux) supports various programming languages, including the ever-popular C#. Thanks to its high-performance runtime, consistent programming model, and extensive library of precoded solutions .NET enables us to incorporate performance, security, reliability, and productivity into our solutions. 

Pave the way for AI innovations, cloud adoption and digital transformation with Microsoft Azure’s suite of virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases. Problem-solving, collaboration with crossfunctional teams and designing scalable solutions are going to be your key skills as an Azure expert. You’ll also familiarise yourself with Azure Active Directory, monitoring tools, and cost management to deliver the continuous integration and delivery, as well as implementing security best practices, quality and compliance that Sopra Steria is known for.  

Our Developers specialise in application and software development while seamlessly integrating systems, so we never lose sight of our business goals. With an eye towards user experience and productivity, you’ll design, code, and test new functionalities while troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and keeping technical documentation in order. Our developers love to design and are always informed of the latest design trends. When fulfilling day-to-day tasks, you’ll always be ready with a solution when there’s a problem. You’ll also collaborate with other teams and never miss a detail so you can deliver solutions that meet Sopra Steria’s quality standards. 

 

Profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

• .NET
• Typescript
• API design
• Security
• Azure services (Azure Functions/App Services, Azure IoT Hub, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Services…)
• OO
• SOLID principles
• Design patterns 
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• Languages: English, and Dutch or French required
